problem:
The inverse of the matrix $F$ is found using row operations, as shown below. What are the row operations corresponding to each step?

$$
\begin{aligned}[F\,|\,I] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ -5 & 2 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=\text{___________} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 1 & 5 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\text{___________} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 & \frac{1}{3} & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 1 & 5 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-2){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 & \frac{1}{3} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 5 & -\frac{2}{3} & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

activity_context.topic_title: Finding the Inverse of a 3x3 Matrix Using Row Operations
